items.sourceFinding: Existing coordinated saves intend to preserve metadata; system folder import and Files sharing/open-in-place are present. There is no credited generic tag facade, and NSURLTagNamesKey is explicitly unavailable on iOS in the installed SDK.
items.requiredProbe: Use the original native Files/document-browser flow on an actual accessible authored-project URL; verify existing tag names/colors survive import, edit, atomic save and export. Files sharing alone does not expose every arbitrary runtime workspace.
items.supportedRemedy: Use public system document UI for tag editing and retain existing workspace coordination/versioned copy semantics. If a private authored-project URL cannot be revealed, use an explicit user-selected export/import copy of that project; do not expose the whole runtime directory or silently relocate the editor. Do not add unavailable Foundation APIs, parse opaque tag data as an invented contract, or add a new File Provider extension solely for this comparison.
items.limit: A direct Scriptable-compatible tag-management API is not claimed. The actual workflow remains an original OS probe; no false completion.

items.authorizedCriterion: Conditional: iCloud sync if supported; conflict/no-data-loss acceptance explicitly required
items.sourceFinding: The existing MiniApps entitlement source declares iCloud.com.itorah.chavrusachat and CloudDocuments/CloudKit. Signed ubiquity entitlement and actual container access have not been verified here. Current directory enumeration alone does not prove remote-placeholder visibility.
items.implementedRemedy: Approved74bd moves root resolution/workspace creation off the main actor, propagates cancellation, qualifies results by request identity and preserves an already opened workspace. A nil container retains an explicit unavailable-state route.
items.conditionalRemedy: After actual signed container access is established, use the existing public NSMetadataQuery ubiquity-documents scope for remote metadata and supported download-status/startDownloading APIs if the original OS probe proves a listing/download gap. Retain selected editor identity, dirty buffers, drafts, coordinated reads/writes and unresolved versions; do not auto-reload over edits.
items.limit: No placeholder implementation, account simulation or cloud/device acceptance was added in74bd. Original iCloud/File Provider probes remain open.

items.sourceFinding: Task10 explicitly calls for the devices/layouts in release notes. Existing Studio uses native NavigationStack/List and real UIKit editor/font picker; that is not actual Duo evidence.
items.supportedRemedy: Run original import/edit/save/gallery flows at applicable compact and expanded/windowed sizes, rotations, large text and RTL on available actual destinations; fix concrete clipping/navigation failures in the existing views. Exact Duo qualification requires that actual device/destination, not a relabeled generic simulator.
items.limit: No bespoke Duo screen or speculative product redesign is automatically required.

items.supportedRemedy: Keep the vendor comparison in the matrix. Do not create a new product screen or make its absence block Task10 without an actual approved criterion.
